scope: Batch 3 (AI Product Editor and Maintainer), development only. Phase 1 of 6: authorised connection of an EXISTING GitHub repository, exact-commit read-only inspection, tenant and revocation safety. Extends the existing repositoryTools session; adds no scheduler, agent loop or runtime. Not for merge or deployment until the founder authorises release.

keep: Canonical scheduler, SoftwareAgent, repositoryTools session, patch workspace and GitHub persistence
Existing GitHub OAuth connection and its revocation semantics
extend: Existing repositories are bound by GitHub immutable repository id, connected account and exact base commit
Tree reads walk truncated trees directory by directory and report partial honestly
Credential-bearing paths are listed but their content is never fetched

schemaImpact.rollout: Additive service-role-only table with RLS and no public grants. Not applied by this change; apply through the verified migration workflow after authorisation.
schemaImpact.rollback: DROP TABLE public.existing_source_projects; (nothing else references it).

auth.description: New /api/existing-source routes require the issued tenant context and are off unless XROGA_EXISTING_SOURCE=1.

tenant.description: Every binding query carries the verified owner; another owner's binding id is indistinguishable from one that does not exist; the same repository linked by two owners stays two bindings.

approval.description: Read-only in this phase: no remote write, branch or PR is possible from these routes.

credentials.description: The connected account token is resolved server-side and never returned; .env, key and credential files are never fetched; secrets inside ordinary files are redacted by the existing tool session.

egress.description: Calls only api.github.com with the connected account's own token, addressed by repository id; no repository content reaches a model in this phase.

cost.description: Bounded tree walks (entry and fetch limits) and the existing per-session blob budget; no model spend.

tests.scope: Link, tenant isolation, revocation, rename and transfer, account change, pinned reads, truncated trees, sensitive paths, traversal, REST error classification and the HTTP routes.
Every client call is a served route with the same method; the router is authenticated; the feature is off by default.

architecture.reason: Adds a binding store and a read-only source service around the existing RepositoryToolSession. No scheduler, agent loop, runtime or authentication system is added.

rollout: Development only. Merge, migration and activation need the founder's explicit authorisation after all six phases and acceptance gates.
rollback: Leave XROGA_EXISTING_SOURCE and NEXT_PUBLIC_XROGA_EXISTING_SOURCE unset: routes answer 503 and the page is absent. Drop the table with the statement above if the migration was applied.
knownGaps: No live GitHub verification (needs an authorised disposable account)
No code index, edit, test or PR delivery yet (Phases 2 to 4)
Installation (GitHub App) binding is recorded as null: the existing connection is an OAuth user token
placeholderClaimsRemaining: Live provider behaviour is unverified; only a faithful in-memory GitHub was exercised

blockers: Batch 3 is development only until the founder authorises release
No approved disposable GitHub account for live verification
